correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no T1w/T2w ratio suffix (MWFmap is myelin water fraction, a different measure).

brainlife.desc: Volumetric myelin map (map.nii.gz), the T1w/T2w ratio computed with Connectome Workbench.
brainlife.name: neuro/myelin-map
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Cortical and tract myelin mapping and summary statistics.

**Not for:** Quantitative myelin content; T1w/T2w is a relative proxy with no bias correction. Use when the T1w and T2w were not aligned.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 14 Apps, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.myelin-map.json

identifying_risks: A ratio of whole-head images keeps the facial outline
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 5 applied under uncertainty: whole-head inputs can leave facial anatomy visible.
tier_conditions: Tier 2 when computed from defaced or brain-extracted images
